inputUnits: Selection-time points per game, converted to points per drive by the shared drive count. Touchdown = 6 plus one extra-point attempt. Field goal = 3. Events are mutually exclusive. Late-clock touchdowns are funded from the same points-per-game budget.
seedPolicy: Primary seed is the first precommitted value (20241015). Seeds were listed before the run and were not reordered or dropped to obtain a PASS.
boundarySensitiveNote: Count of primary-seed games whose home ML sits within 0.01 of 0.45 or 0.55. Those games can enter or leave the official cohort when the draw noise moves.

priorE2aClaim.engine: nfl-drive before ppg-per-drive-v1: points per game were passed in as points per drive, then NCAAF inputs were multiplied by 0.48
priorE2aClaim.reason: The 2026-10-14 PASS used the same unit mismatch as the NFL draws that sat near 42 points per team. The 0.48 college scale was a patch on that mismatch, not a separate engine. This run is a new measurement. A numeric PASS does not restore that claim.

formMethodology: Games ordered by kickoff. A prior game enters form after a credible ESPN last-play wall clock (2.5 to 12 hours after kickoff). When that stamp is missing or implausible, availability falls back to kickoff plus 4 hours. That fallback is an assumption, not proof the game ended. The evaluated game is added after it is scored. Venue split blends with L10.

completionAccounting.uncertainty: ESPN meta.lastPlayWallClock is the latest play timestamp on the summary, not the official final whistle. Stamps under 2.5 hours or over 12 hours after kickoff are ignored. Games without a credible stamp use kickoff plus 4 hours, which can release a long game early or hold a short game late.

completionSensitivity.rule: credible last-play stamps only; kickoff-plus-4-hours priors are excluded
completionSensitivity.note: Sensitivity check. Primary metrics still use the kickoff-plus-4-hours assumption wherever a credible stamp is missing or implausible.

provenance.engine: nfl-drive before ppg-per-drive-v1 (points per game fed in as points per drive, then NCAAF ×0.48)
